## Type of change

- [ ] feat - new user-visible feature
- [ ] fix - bug fix
- [ ] refactor - internal change, no behaviour difference
- [ ] docs - documentation only
- [ ] test - tests only
- [ ] ci - build / CI / tooling
- [ ] chore - other maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are in English.
- [ ] No AI co-author trailers in any commit.
- [ ] Public types and methods have XML documentation.
- [ ] Functions stay at or under 30 lines.
- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds in Release.
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes locally.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if user-visible behaviour changed.
